in_marathi.name: Ayanyak
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sacred
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ayanyak हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ayanyak is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Aya' meaning 'lord' and 'Nyak' meaning 'sacred' or 'pure'. This name is used to denote someone who is the lord or protector of the sacred. In Hindu mythology, Ayanyak is an epithet for various deities, particularly Lord Vishnu and Lord Ganesha, who are revered as the protectors of the dharma or righteous path.
